svg.title: The AERI subtask loop, start to finish, in six lanes
svg.desc: Earlier versions ran on the robot only in external mode, with an agent answering for the vision model; this version and the local vision model have not run on the robot. Prepare: you start the robot stack; terminal D checks GPU, memory and ports and starts the local vision model, which by default sleeps, and then the policy service. Start: the model lists the objects, you confirm them with y and the list is frozen. Every round: you release it with Enter in D; the model plans subtasks within the list; code writes each instruction from fixed templates; the policy runs a subtask for up to 200 steps and holds; the model checks the facts on still frames; D moves to the next subtask or retries up to 5 times; an s or f you press during the forward loop labels the round; the arm homes; the reverse loop restores the scene the same way and homes again. End: D stops both models and checks they are gone. The page only shows the run.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only terminal D moves the robot and releases each round; the page cannot.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The model's “done” only moves the flow on; the result is your s / f / d. Stop works at any time.

svg.text: Out of list, malformed plan, unknown check, too many retries, no GPU or memory to wake: the run waits for a person.
